summary: I submitted five scenarios. I read the source and found one concrete defect: the inventory module's reservation availability check validates each entry separately and never sums entries that share an inventory item. A cart with lines for two variants of WIDGET (6 PIECE plus 3 TWOPACK, or 4 plus 4) needs 12 units against 10 in stock, and each line passes alone. I did not see any run results, so none of this is confirmed by a failed check. The other three scenarios test the process-local lock with two servers and duplicate completion of one cart on one and two servers, and I found no code defect for those. I did not test stock-location-mixup, because the scenarios only have one stock location. I also did not find evidence for stale-counter-write or payment-order-link in the paths I read.
